잠언-29-1.title: 잠언 29장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-1.exegesis: 28. The elevation of the wicked to power drives men to seek refuge from tyranny (compare Pr 28:12 ; 11:10 ; Psa 12:8 ).
잠언-29-1.theologicalNote: 28. The elevation of the wicked to power drives men to seek refuge from tyranny (compare Pr 28:12 ; 11:10 ; Psa 12:8 ).

잠언-29-2.title: 잠언 29장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 29 Pr 29:1-27 . 1. hardeneth ... neck-- obstinately refuses counsel ( 2Ki 17:14 ; Ne 9:16 ). destroyed-- literally, "shivered" or "utterly broken to pieces." without remedy-- literally, "without healing" or repairing.
잠언-29-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 29 Pr 29:1-27 . 1. hardeneth ... neck-- obstinately refuses counsel ( 2Ki 17:14 ; Ne 9:16 ). destroyed-- literally, "shivered" or "utterly broken to pieces." without remedy-- literally, "without healing" or repairing.

잠언-29-3.title: 잠언 29장 3절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-3.exegesis: 2. (Compare Pr 11:10 ; 28:28 ). in authority-- (Compare Margin), increased in power.
잠언-29-3.theologicalNote: 2. (Compare Pr 11:10 ; 28:28 ). in authority-- (Compare Margin), increased in power.

잠언-29-5.title: 잠언 29장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-5.exegesis: 4. by judgment-- that is, righteous decisions, opposed to those procured by gifts (compare Pr 28:21 ), by which good government is perverted. land-- for nation.
잠언-29-5.theologicalNote: 4. by judgment-- that is, righteous decisions, opposed to those procured by gifts (compare Pr 28:21 ), by which good government is perverted. land-- for nation.

잠언-29-6.title: 잠언 29장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-6.exegesis: 5. (Compare Pr 26:28 ). spreadeth ... feet-- By misleading him as to his real character, the flatterer brings him to evil, prepared by himself or others.
잠언-29-6.theologicalNote: 5. (Compare Pr 26:28 ). spreadeth ... feet-- By misleading him as to his real character, the flatterer brings him to evil, prepared by himself or others.

잠언-29-7.title: 잠언 29장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-7.exegesis: 6. In-- or, "By" the transgression-- he is brought into difficulty ( Pr 12:13 ), but the righteous go on prospering, and so sing or rejoice.
잠언-29-7.theologicalNote: 6. In-- or, "By" the transgression-- he is brought into difficulty ( Pr 12:13 ), but the righteous go on prospering, and so sing or rejoice.

잠언-29-8.title: 잠언 29장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-8.exegesis: 7. considereth-- literally, "knows," as Psa 1:6 . the cause-- that is, in courts of justice (compare Pr 29:14 ). The voluntary neglect of it by the wicked ( Pr 28:27 ) occasions oppression.
잠언-29-8.theologicalNote: 7. considereth-- literally, "knows," as Psa 1:6 . the cause-- that is, in courts of justice (compare Pr 29:14 ). The voluntary neglect of it by the wicked ( Pr 28:27 ) occasions oppression.

잠언-29-9.title: 잠언 29장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-9.exegesis: 8. Scornful men-- those who contemptuously disregard God's law. bring-- (Compare Margin), kindle strife. turn away wrath-- that is, "abate wrath."
잠언-29-9.theologicalNote: 8. Scornful men-- those who contemptuously disregard God's law. bring-- (Compare Margin), kindle strife. turn away wrath-- that is, "abate wrath."

잠언-29-10.title: 잠언 29장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-10.exegesis: 9. contendeth-- that is, in law. whether ... laugh-- The fool, whether angry or good-humored, is unsettled; or referring the words to the wise man, the sense is, that all his efforts, severe or gentle, are unavailing to pacify the fool.
잠언-29-10.theologicalNote: 9. contendeth-- that is, in law. whether ... laugh-- The fool, whether angry or good-humored, is unsettled; or referring the words to the wise man, the sense is, that all his efforts, severe or gentle, are unavailing to pacify the fool.

잠언-29-11.title: 잠언 29장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-11.exegesis: 10. bloodthirsty-- (Compare Margin), murderers ( Psa 5:6 ; 26:9 ). hate, &c.-- ( Pr 1:11 ; Ge 3:4 ). seek ... soul-- that is, to preserve it.
잠언-29-11.theologicalNote: 10. bloodthirsty-- (Compare Margin), murderers ( Psa 5:6 ; 26:9 ). hate, &c.-- ( Pr 1:11 ; Ge 3:4 ). seek ... soul-- that is, to preserve it.

잠언-29-12.title: 잠언 29장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-12.exegesis: 11. (Compare Pr 12:16 ; 16:32 ). mind-- or, "spirit," for anger or any ill passion which the righteous restrain.
잠언-29-12.theologicalNote: 11. (Compare Pr 12:16 ; 16:32 ). mind-- or, "spirit," for anger or any ill passion which the righteous restrain.

잠언-29-14.title: 잠언 29장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-14.exegesis: 13. (Compare Pr 22:2 ). deceitful man-- literally, "man of vexations," an exactor. the Lord ... their eyes-- sustains their lives ( 1Sa 14:27 ; Psa 13:3 ); that is, both depend on Him, and He will do justice.
잠언-29-14.theologicalNote: 13. (Compare Pr 22:2 ). deceitful man-- literally, "man of vexations," an exactor. the Lord ... their eyes-- sustains their lives ( 1Sa 14:27 ; Psa 13:3 ); that is, both depend on Him, and He will do justice.

잠언-29-15.title: 잠언 29장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-15.exegesis: 14. (Compare Pr 20:28 ; 25:5 ). Such is the character of the King of kings ( Psa 72:4 , 12 ).
잠언-29-15.theologicalNote: 14. (Compare Pr 20:28 ; 25:5 ). Such is the character of the King of kings ( Psa 72:4 , 12 ).

잠언-29-17.title: 잠언 29장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-17.exegesis: 16. (Compare Pr 29:2 , 12 ; Psa 12:1-8 ). shall see ... fall-- and triumph in it (Psa 37:34-38; 58: 10, 11 ).
잠언-29-17.theologicalNote: 16. (Compare Pr 29:2 , 12 ; Psa 12:1-8 ). shall see ... fall-- and triumph in it (Psa 37:34-38; 58: 10, 11 ).

잠언-29-18.title: 잠언 29장 18절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-18.exegesis: 17. (Compare Pr 29:3 , 15 ; Pr 19:18 ). give thee rest-- peace and quiet (compare Pr 29:9 ).
잠언-29-18.theologicalNote: 17. (Compare Pr 29:3 , 15 ; Pr 19:18 ). give thee rest-- peace and quiet (compare Pr 29:9 ).

잠언-29-19.title: 잠언 29장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-19.exegesis: 18. no vision-- instruction in God's truth, which was by prophets, through visions ( 1Sa 3:1 ). people perish-- (Compare Margin), are deprived of moral restraints. keepeth the law-- has, and observes, instruction ( Pr 14:11 , 34 ; Psa 19:11 ).
잠언-29-19.theologicalNote: 18. no vision-- instruction in God's truth, which was by prophets, through visions ( 1Sa 3:1 ). people perish-- (Compare Margin), are deprived of moral restraints. keepeth the law-- has, and observes, instruction ( Pr 14:11 , 34 ; Psa 19:11 ).

잠언-29-20.title: 잠언 29장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-20.exegesis: 19. A servant-- who lacks good principle. corrected-- or discovered. will not answer-- that is, will not obey.
잠언-29-20.theologicalNote: 19. A servant-- who lacks good principle. corrected-- or discovered. will not answer-- that is, will not obey.

잠언-29-21.title: 잠언 29장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-21.exegesis: 20. (Compare Pr 21:5 ). hasty in ... words?-- implying self-conceit ( Pr 26:12 ).
잠언-29-21.theologicalNote: 20. (Compare Pr 21:5 ). hasty in ... words?-- implying self-conceit ( Pr 26:12 ).

잠언-29-22.title: 잠언 29장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-22.exegesis: 21. become his son-- assume the place and privileges of one.
잠언-29-22.theologicalNote: 21. become his son-- assume the place and privileges of one.

잠언-29-23.title: 잠언 29장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-23.exegesis: 22. (Compare Pr 15:18 ). Such are delighted by discord and violence.
잠언-29-23.theologicalNote: 22. (Compare Pr 15:18 ). Such are delighted by discord and violence.

잠언-29-24.title: 잠언 29장 24절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-24.exegesis: 23. (Compare Pr 16:18 ; 18:12 ). honour ... spirit-- or, "such shall lay hold on honor" ( Pr 11:16 ).
잠언-29-24.theologicalNote: 23. (Compare Pr 16:18 ; 18:12 ). honour ... spirit-- or, "such shall lay hold on honor" ( Pr 11:16 ).

잠언-29-25.title: 잠언 29장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-25.exegesis: 24. hateth ... soul-- (Compare Pr 8:36 ). heareth cursing-- ( Le 5:1 ), risks the punishment, rather than reveal truth.
잠언-29-25.theologicalNote: 24. hateth ... soul-- (Compare Pr 8:36 ). heareth cursing-- ( Le 5:1 ), risks the punishment, rather than reveal truth.

잠언-29-26.title: 잠언 29장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-26.exegesis: 25. The fear ... snare-- involves men in difficulty (compare Pr 29:6 ). shall be safe-- (Compare Margin; Pr 18:10 ).
잠언-29-26.theologicalNote: 25. The fear ... snare-- involves men in difficulty (compare Pr 29:6 ). shall be safe-- (Compare Margin; Pr 18:10 ).

잠언-29-27.title: 잠언 29장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-29-27.exegesis: 26. (Compare Margin; Psa 27:8 ). God alone will and can do exact justice.
잠언-29-27.theologicalNote: 26. (Compare Margin; Psa 27:8 ). God alone will and can do exact justice.
